bibl.title: Vocables and Microtones in Ancient Greek Music.
bibl.seg: Armand D'Angour, Vocables and Microtones in Ancient Greek Music.
Greek and Roman Musical Studies 4 (2016) pp. 273-285, figg.
bibl.note: Discusses ways in which non-lexical utterances are linked in ancient Greek music to the representation of musical phrases. The Orestes papyrus [P. Vindob. Graec. Inv. 2315 (= MP3 411; LDAB 1047)] is examined in detail to see if the enharmonic musical setting is affected in any way by principles of vowel pitch modification, with the conclusion that it is.
